_note: density= — the universal subtree density knob (component-library.md W9 item 5): `density="comfortable|compact"` on ANY element pins the control-metric plane (paddings/heights/gaps derive from density-scoped tokens) for that element and everything under it. resolve[] pins the attribute fold: the vocabulary is exactly `comfortable | compact`, exact lowercase after trim; anything else (unknown word, wrong case, empty, whitespace-only, absent) resolves to NO pin — the element stays transparent to its ancestors' density. effective[] pins the subtree law: `chain` is the authored raw density attributes from the ROOT to the ELEMENT (null = not authored); the NEAREST ancestor whose fold resolves wins — an invalid nearer value never masks an outer pin — and with no pin anywhere the PLATFORM default applies: compact on a desktop fine-pointer surface (`finePointer` — each adapter owns its own detection: web keys the density token tables' media condition, native desktops are fine-pointer by identity), comfortable everywhere else. On web the CSS custom-property cascade IS this fold (mount stamps data-dsx-density only for a resolved pin; the token tables in theme.ts do the rest); the native kernels run effective() directly and present through their existing size systems.

resolve.name: an unknown word is no pin
a word list is no pin

effective.name: no pins on touch defaults comfortable
no pins on a desktop fine pointer defaults compact
a compact pin beats the touch default
a comfortable pin beats the desktop default
the nearest pin wins over an outer pin
the nearest pin wins regardless of pointer
a pin inherits through unpinned descendants
a mid-chain pin reaches a deep element
an invalid nearer value never masks an outer pin
an invalid pin alone leaves the platform default
an unauthored chain is the platform default
